newsitem.title: USA: DIVING-SORGI WINS SECOND NATIONAL TITLE.
newsitem.headline: DIVING-SORGI WINS SECOND NATIONAL TITLE.

text.p: Schoolgirl Erica Sorgi won her second national title Thursday at the USA Senior National Diving Championships Thursday.

Sorgi, 15, won the 1-metre springboard title, a non-Olympic event, and qualified for the September 10-14 World Cup championships in Mexico City and world aquatic championships in January in Perth, Australia.
Sorgi topped a 30-diver field, pared down to six for the final round. She totaled 284.79 points. Her individual dive scores were never lower than 7s in the five-dive final.
The seven-day World Cup and world championship qualifying meet continues through Sunday. It is only the second major diving meet in the United States since the Summer Olympics in Atlanta.
